question: Do the eight powers and attainment of siddhis constitute the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The eight powers are included in this enumeration.
Attainment of siddhis is included in this enumeration.
These attainments are identified as the root Kaula.
inference: The eight powers together with the attainment of siddhis belong to and define the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact internal structure of the fused token siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ allows more than one syntactic parsing.
plain_english: And the eight powers, along with the attainment of siddhis, are the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
